summary_en: ASNOVA will cancel all treasury shares held as of September 30, 2026, ahead of a planned stock-for-stock merger to establish a pure holding company structure on October 1, 2026. The cancellation prevents the holding company from receiving shares attributable to treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
ASNOVA announced on September 14, 2026, that its Board of Directors resolved to cancel all treasury shares held at the reference date (the time immediately before the holding company acquires all issued shares of the Company through the planned stock-for-stock merger). The cancellation is scheduled for September 30, 2026.

The company is implementing this cancellation in connection with its planned transition to a pure holding company structure, with the establishment of a wholly-owned parent company named ASNOVA Companies scheduled for October 1, 2026. By canceling treasury shares before the merger becomes effective, the company avoids the allocation of parent company shares in exchange for treasury shares.

The disclosure provides that as of August 31, 2026, the company held 548 treasury shares against 12,437,852 issued shares excluding treasury stock. The specific number of shares to be canceled corresponds to all treasury shares held at the reference date.
